title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 115
paragraphs: In this way the Athenians took seven of the ships, but with the rest the barbarians pushed off from land. Picking up the Eretrian captives from the island where they had left them, they sailed around Sunion with the intention of reaching the city before the Athenians could. A charge went around Athens that they had conceived this plan through a scheme of the Alcmaeonids: these men, it was said, had made an arrangement with the Persians and signaled to them with a shield once the Persians were back aboard their ships.
